description: Traceable qualitative-text analysis using an explicit codebook, coded excerpts, reflexive notes, disagreements, and evidence-bounded thematic synthesis.

rules.reason: Qualitative text requires a codebook and traceable coding rather than tabular EDA.

interface.short_description: Analyse qualitative text with a visible coding trail.
interface.long_description: Supports codebook development, traceable excerpt coding, reflexive notes, disagreement handling, and themes bounded by the coded evidence.
interface.default_prompt: Help me analyse this qualitative corpus with a traceable codebook.
